Special Qualities: Scent, vermin traits

Imported from the d20 SRD; verify attacks and skills in-game. Full rules at d20srd.org.
statBlock.organization: Gang (2-6) or crew (6-11 plus 1 giant ant soldier)

system.biography:
Giant ants are among the hardiest and most adaptable vermin. Soldiers and workers are about 6 feet long, while queens can grow to a length of 9 feet.

Acid Sting (Ex)

A giant soldier ant has a stinger and an acid-producing gland in its abdomen. If it successfully grabs an opponent, it can attempt to sting each round (+3 attack bonus). A hit with the sting attack deals 1d4+1 points of piercing damage and 1d4 points of acid damage.

Improved Grab (Ex)

To use this ability, a giant ant must hit with its bite attack. A giant soldier ant that wins the ensuing grapple check establishes a hold and can sting.

Skills

*Giant ants have a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent and a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. A giant ant can always choose to take 10 on Climb checks, even if rushed or threatened.

system.description: You can follow the trails of creatures and characters across most types of terrain.
system.benefit: To find tracks or to follow them for 1 hour requires a Survival check. You must make another Survival check every hour to continue following the tracks. The DC depends on the surface and the prevailing conditions.
system.special: A ranger automatically gains Track as a bonus feat at 1st level. He need not select it.

system.description: Check: With each successful Climb check, you can advance up, down, or across a slope, wall, or other steep incline (or even a ceiling with handholds) at one-quarter your normal speed.

What it does (SRD): Scent lets the creature detect opponents by smell, usually out to about 30 ft. (strong scents farther, very weak scents closer). It can use scent to pinpoint a square once it is within 5 ft., and to track by Survival. Wind and water affect what it can smell.

ThirdEra: Scent (30 ft.) is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects. The character sheet includes it with other senses; Survival checks to track by scent still use the normal skill rules unless you add separate bonuses elsewhere.

What it does (SRD): The creature can see in total darkness out to the distance set on this copy (default from the stat block). Darkvision is black and white only unless another rule says otherwise.

ThirdEra: Distance is under CGS parameters and overrides on this item (merged over the canonical template). The stat block’s distance is preserved when migrating from older packs.
